title: trigonochloa uniflora
intro: Trigonochloa uniflora, commonly known as the single-flowered trigonochloa, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Trigonochloa uniflora are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although further research is needed to confirm the exact composition and effects of Trigonochloa uniflora.
